children: US commercial bank's Q3 adjusted EPS beat analyst expectations, net income rose quarter-over-quarter
Company's net interest income grew quarter-over-quarter, net interest margin improved
Company repurchased 679,000 shares for $57.4 mln in Q3
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future quarters
HIGHER NET INTEREST INCOME - Co said growth in net interest income and improved net interest margin were driven by asset repricing and increased loan yields
DEPOSIT GROWTH - Co attributed deposit growth mainly to inflows from business and consumer accounts
LOAN GROWTH - Co said loan growth was supported by strong demand for home equity and residential mortgages
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Independent Bank Corp (Massachusetts) is $95.00, about 24.9% above its October 14 closing price of $76.04
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
